content.text: You’re in Nigeria, Ghana, or Venezuela. Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad are unavailable. You sell ebooks, templates, or plugins but cannot collect payment. Conventional platforms lock you out. This guide deploys a sovereign commerce stack. You own the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-every-detail-you-6|COREMERCH guide to digital]]-product-stores-kyc-payments-4|The Full]]. No platform fees. No subscriptions. Lifetime access. Built on GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments. Pressure-tested in Zimbabwe against currency collapse and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/financial-sovereignty-digital-creators-crypto-what-nobody-tells-19|financial]] isolation. By the end of this guide, you’ll have a fully operational digital store processing crypto payments and delivering products automatically.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-automated-digital-product-10. content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Platforms fail when they restrict access or increase fees. Gumroad charges 10% per sale. NOWPayments charges 0.5%. At 100 sales of a $97 product, you retain $921 more per month. This stack eliminates platform dependency. GitHub Pages hosts your store for free. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic. Supabase stores orders. Google Drive delivers files. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain. No single point of failure. No recurring costs. You own the code, data, and deployment. This is infrastructure sovereignty, not a workaround.
What You Need Before You Deploy

You need three things: a digital product, a crypto wallet, and a domain (optional). Your product—ebook, template, or plugin—must be ready for delivery. Your crypto wallet will receive payments. Use BSC, Solana, or TRON for low fees (under $0.10 per transaction). A domain is optional but recommended for professionalism. If you skip it, GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages will provide a free URL. Gather these assets before proceeding. The stack deploys in 48 hours once you start.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start with NOWPayments. Create an account and generate API keys. Select your preferred cryptocurrency. Set the price in USD. NOWPayments converts it at transaction time. Next, configure file delivery. Upload your product to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Generate a shareable link. Write the backend logic in Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. This script verifies payment via NOWPayments’ webhook and delivers the file automatically. Test the flow manually before deployment.
NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction—95% less than Gumroad’s 10% fee.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your store to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Connect your custom domain if using one. Test the entire pipeline: simulate a purchase, verify the payment webhook, and confirm file delivery. Once live, share your store URL with your audience. The first transaction will confirm your infrastructure is operational. Monitor the Supabase or Google Sheets dashboard for order tracking. You now own a fully functional digital commerce stack.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With the stack deployed, focus on scaling. Add more products by duplicating the delivery logic. Optimize for SEO by updating GitHub Pages metadata. Integrate email marketing via Cloudflare Workers to notify buyers. Upgrade to the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and end-to-end testing. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates for advanced scaling. Your infrastructure is now a foundation, not a limitation.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook without PayPal or Stripe, deploy a sovereign commerce stack. Use GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto processing. Upload your ebook to Google Drive and generate a shareable link. Write a script to verify payment via NOWPayments’ webhook and deliver the file automatically. Test the flow, deploy to GitHub Pages, and share your store URL. This eliminates platform fees and gives you full data ownership.
You own the entire stack after deployment. No platform access required.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re selling notion templates for USDT or Bitcoin, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates for instant deployment. Available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit provides everything needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. Whether you’re selling fonts, presets, or software, this infrastructure ensures you own the entire pipeline—no platform fees, no restrictions.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Prepare your digital product and crypto wallet. 2. Create a NOWPayments account and generate API keys. 3. Upload your product to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 4. Write backend logic in Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. 5. Test the payment and delivery pipeline manually. 6. Deploy your store to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 7. Share your store URL with your audience. 8. Monitor orders via Supabase or Google Sheets. 9. Scale by adding more products and optimizing SEO. 10. Upgrade to the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for advanced features.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m in a country with strict financial regulations?
Yes. This stack uses decentralized crypto payments and free hosting tools. It bypasses traditional financial restrictions. NOWPayments processes payments without KYC, and you own the infrastructure.
How do I handle refunds with crypto payments?
Refunds are processed manually via your crypto wallet. Communicate the refund policy clearly in your store. Since you control the wallet, you decide when and how to issue refunds.
What if I want to sell multiple products?
Duplicate the delivery logic for each product. Use a database like Supabase to track orders and product IDs. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes multi-product deployment and testing.
Is this stack secure for handling payments?
Yes. NOWPayments verifies payments on-chain, and the webhook triggers file delivery only after confirmation. Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script ensure secure backend logic.
Can I use my own domain with this stack?
Yes. Connect your custom domain to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration for email security.
